A LITTLE CHESS SCHOOL

Learn with Pip ♡

Open a card whenever you need a hand
♙Meet the piecesWho's who on the board?+

♙ Pawn: forward one square (two on its first move), captures diagonally.

♖ Rook: straight lines. ♗ Bishop: diagonals.

♘ Knight: jumps in an L shape. ♕ Queen: straight or diagonal.

♔ King: one square in any direction. Keep it safe!

♘Make a clever moveSee, think, then play+

Tap a piece, then tap a glowing destination. Try to control the middle four squares. Before moving, ask: “Can my opponent take this piece?”

Need help? The Hint button finds a move for you.

♚Win the kingdomCheck, checkmate and draws+

Check means the king is under attack. You must make it safe.

Checkmate ends the game when the king cannot escape.

Sometimes neither side can win: that's a draw. Castling and en passant work here, too!
